summary: Miniature SPDT snap-action micro switch with a rectangular body, a hinged bump lever on top, and three solder pins on the bottom edge. Two round through-holes run across the body thickness for mounting. Bounds are the body only, from the stated 19.8 x 6.4 x 10.2 mm. The lever and pins are excluded.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat front face of the body with the two mounting holes.
Flat back face of the body, where the mounting holes exit.

notes: The images show no printed dimensions, and the supplied dimensions are marked unverified. The body size is taken from the product description. The hole diameter (about 2.3 mm) and hole positions were estimated by scaling the side-view image to the 19.8 mm body length. The two holes are about 10.3 mm apart, roughly 2.8 mm below the body's vertical center. The 18.5 mm lever extends beyond the body envelope, and the three pins hang below it. Pin size and spacing are not stated, so they are not modeled. The x axis runs along the body length, y is the height from pins to lever side, and z is the thickness.
